# Search tab research shapes

Observed on 2026-10-24; see `docs/research/slack-data-access.md`, “Search for the Search tab, live”. These methods and response subsets are not yet production schema contracts, so they live outside the root recorded-response decode cases.

The files, people and channels files are redacted envelopes with one item each. The facets and extracts files are subsets reconstructed from the observed key/type census. All strings are `redacted`, all numbers are zero, and reconstructed booleans are false placeholders. Dynamic IDs in object keys are replaced too. No original identity, message, query or credential is retained.
